title: In the Way
text: “Well then, I’ll be the one to decide how long we can hold out. Let’s go ahead and check it out.”

“What? That condescending attitude. Can’t you even show some respect for our opponent? The Shield Hero respects our will no matter what our background is. Just because they’re called ‘Heroes’ doesn’t mean every single one of them—”
“Wyndia-chan, let’s just leave it at that, okay?”

The Assistant said this with a look of annoyance, but apparently Keel, Rival, and Sakura-chan stepped in to calm things down. After that, Ren, Keel, and the others reportedly made swift progress deeper into the island’s interior.
“There should be a spot up ahead where a boss appears. You guys shouldn’t go that way—stay around here and fight. At your level, you should be able to handle it.”

So said Ren, reportedly issuing this order in the area just before a boss that’s considered quite a challenge on the island. I think even Keel and the others would have an easy time with a boss of this island’s caliber, though. Well, since Ren doesn’t know how to power up, that’s probably why he made that call.
“Aren’t you going to take on that boss?”
“You’d have a tough time against the boss, right? Let’s figure out the monsters’ behavior here first before we act. Don’t you dare go off on your own to take down the boss.”
“Ah… yeah. Got it, Sword Guy.”
“Don’t push yourselves too hard. You’re right at the limit of what you can handle.”
“Wait, aren’t you going to fight with us?”
“Fighting in a group is inefficient. You guys need to coordinate your attacks properly.”

Apparently, before the Assistant could take a step forward, looking annoyed, Ren had already gone off on his own to the opposite side of the altar where the boss was about to appear. Even so, back then, Ren still prioritized solo play over party play. I feel like the Ren I met in the first world was always hanging out with someone, though…
“What’s with that guy?!”

It’s said that while the Assistant muttered in annoyance, Keel and the others continued to take down monsters. Just as the monsters that kept appearing had become so weak that they were getting bored, Ren reportedly returned. Apparently, he sheathed the carcasses of the monsters they’d defeated as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
“Looks like you’re fighting pretty well.”
“They don’t put up much of a fight, do they?”
“Yeah, yeah—they’re so weak it’s making me sleepy…”
“That complacency will be your undoing. This is the hunting ground that suits you guys, after all.”
“Don’t get so high and mighty…”
“They’re so weak it’s making my body sluggish.”
The Assistant’s been in a fighting mood the whole time. Well, since it’s about avenging her parents, I guess you could say it’s understandable.
“Why don’t we head over to the boss already? I’m getting bored of this.”
“Hmph, fine. If you look like you’re going to be a burden, get out of here fast.”
“I’ll do my best not to be! Right, everyone!”
“Exactly—I want to bring Mel-chan a souvenir.”
“I wonder which one of us will end up being the burden.”
“Big sis, just hang in there a little longer.”
And so, even though Ren knew he was scoffing at Keel and the others for their reckless challenge, they apparently made it to the altar at the very heart of the island.
“So, what are your signature attacks?”
“Isn’t it a little too late to be asking that? The Shield Hero asked before the battle even started.”
“What?”
“Wyndia-chan, calm down! I’m gonna slice ’em up with my dual daggers!”
“Sakura also uses dual swords—and she can cast Magic, too!”
“…I’ll provide support with Magic.”
“I’ve got bites and breath attacks—I’m great at close combat!”
And so, it seems they each explained their specialty attacks to Ren.
“I see. There’s a bit of a bias in our classes, but I guess that’s to be expected since you’re Naofumi’s allies.”
“Hmm?”

The monster that appeared at that moment was apparently a Karma Dog. Since they’d been easily taking down the Karma Dog Familia just moments before, they apparently thought this battle would be over in the blink of an eye as well.
“Alright! You guys, fight exactly as I tell you!”
“Got it! What do we need to do?”
“First, dodge this monster’s attacks and draw its attention. Then, each of you unleash your strongest attack!”

I like simple battle strategies too. After all, I took down the boss and the rest of the group—including the boss—in one hit with Itsuki and the others. Apparently, the Karma Dog’s attack speed seemed quite slow to Keel and the others, so it wasn’t impossible to dodge.
“This guy doesn’t seem that strong. The monster I fought with my big bro was way tougher.”
“With Naofumi? That kind of complacency could cost you your life.”
“You’re always saying that.”
“Whatever. Let’s just take it down for now.”
Apparently, Keel tried to quickly dodge the enemy’s attack, but Ren was standing right in the path he was trying to escape to.
“Big bro, you’re in the way!”
Saying that, Keel made a sharp turn to change the direction of his evasion, but the Karma Dog Familia switched its target to Ren.
“What are you trying to do, passing it off to me?! Think a little more!”
“If it were me, I’d grab it. Can’t you even hold it back?”
It’s said that Keel replied with a slightly annoyed tone. After all, this dog hates being yelled at. I think he was rambling about how things were before he was bought by my Father.
“Naofumi’s going to take this? Cut the jokes—dodging is the right move.”
“Hmm?”
It seems that just as Sakura-chan tried to parry and deflect the Karma Dog as it lunged at Ren with her sword, Ren grabbed her by the collar and started pulling her toward him.
“What are you doing?!”
“That’s exactly what I’d say!　Are you crazy, trying to block an attack from a monster like that?!”
“It’s fine if I deflect it.”
“Gaelion’s going for it!”
It seems the Rival, who had been fluttering about, suddenly dove down to try and bite him.
“Meteor Sword! Ah, don’t go attacking on your own!”
It seems Ren unleashed his signature Meteor Sword. Stars flew toward the Rival as well as the Karma Dog.
“That’s dangerous! Think before you act!”
The Rival narrowly dodged Ren’s attack and protested. By the time the Rival said that, the Assistant had already begun chanting a Magic spell.
“Land Spike!”
He summoned an earthen spear, intending to hinder the Karma Dog’s movements. However, it was just as Ren was about to dash forward and attack.
“Uwaaaah—w-what the—! Think about your timing!”
Blocked by the earthen spear, Ren reportedly snapped in annoyance.
“Hey, Sword Guy. I’m pretty sure you’re the one with the worst teamwork here.”
“Sakura thinks so too. You’ve been running around all over the place by yourself this whole time.”
“Gaelion thinks so too. You’re all over the place.”
“Sword Guy, aren’t you getting tired running around like that?”
“No way. You guys are the ones making reckless attacks and not looking out for your teammates. Now then, you—the Magic guy, Wyndia, was it? Cast a support spell. Let’s finish this in one go.”

At that point, Ren reportedly stepped back momentarily and asked his Assistant to cast a support spell. After finishing her concentration, the assistant realized what was happening and glared at Ren with displeasure.
“What are you doing to Gaelion?!”
“It’s because you charge in without thinking about teamwork! Don’t confuse courage with recklessness! You guys are weak, so if you don’t coordinate properly, you’ll die!”

At that point, it seems the assistant’s patience finally snapped. It’s said that Keel, Sakura-chan, and their Rival heard a sound like something snapping. Slowly, the Assistant approached Ren and shoved him with all her might in the opposite direction of the boss.
“Whoa—”
The force of the shove from the Assistant—whose abilities had been enhanced by Father—was immense, and Ren was sent flying backward, crashing into a large tree.
“You’re the biggest hindrance! Just stay back there!”
It’s said that the Assistant’s Magical Power blazed out from her body, taking the shape of a dragon. It’s hard to believe, isn’t it?
“W-Wyndia…-chan?”
“S-She’s angry.”
“Big sis, calm down. If you don’t hold back, Naofumi will get mad at you. Gaelion wants to earn points with Naofumi. I don’t want to end up like Kou.”
Apparently, she threw out these words—which didn’t exactly serve as persuasion—but the Assistant ignored her and continued.
“I’ve reached my limit. I have to take it down quickly and teach it a lesson!”
“Kya, kyaaun…”

It seems even the Karma Dog was cowering with its tail tucked between its legs, terrified by the Assistant’s killing intent. Then, the Assistant glared fiercely at the Karma Dog before pointing at it.
“Everyone… Charge!”
“O-oh!”
“Oh!”
“I’m scared!”

Driven by the Assistant’s killing intent, Keel, Sakura-chan, and their Rival launched a simultaneous attack, and they reportedly managed to take down the Karma Dog with ease. It’s said the whole thing took just a few minutes. By the time Ren—who’d been blown away and was writhing in agony—got back on his feet and rushed over, the Karma Dog was already dead.
“What the hell are you doing, all of a sudden?!”
“What am I doing? That’s exactly what I’d like to ask you!”
The Assistant reportedly yelled back at the enraged Ren.
“Hmph, what are you getting so worked up about? I’m only pointing this out because the way you two fight is a complete mess!”
“Pointing it out? You’re just getting in the way!”
“There are people just like you in *Brave Star Online*, a game I know well.”
Renn reportedly crossed his arms and glared at the Assistant with a look of contempt. I doubt you’d recognize the name of that online game, though.

“This is a boss battle, yet you lack any fighting spirit. On top of that, you’re just flailing around with no real drive… No, even if you have the drive, you’re amateurs who don’t know how to fight. Naofumi might be soft, but I’m not.”
“What do you mean the Shield Hero is soft?! He takes the utmost care not to get us hurt so we can fight more easily! And what about you? One wrong move and everyone would’ve been injured!”
“Hmph, Naofumi’s reliable? He’s looking out for you lot despite a massive level gap? That’s impossible.”
After snorting derisively at her Father, Ren reportedly delivered an even more decisive line.
“Look around a little more while you fight! All you need to do is keep the boss’s attention! I’ll deliver the finishing blow while you’re at it.”
Once again, there was reportedly a sound of something tearing—even louder than before.
